Mauve or mauve blend Shrub.
Exhibition name: Rainy Blue
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Evers (Germany, before 2012).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 2012 as 'Rainy Blue'.
rows.Bloom: Purple blend or mauve. Mild fragrance. up to 57 petals. Average diameter 2.25". In small clusters, rosette bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Notes:
Sold only in Japan.
